answer: Attestations are weighted by whether the two agents have ever settled real work together, so a ring that only vouches inward earns almost nothing, and each submission carries a fresh nonce that voids any replay of an older one. Because the weight spiral needs genuine reciprocity, breaking in costs more than joining: an attacker must first do honest trades across an atlas of unrelated counterparties, and the fable collapses on the first reused nonce.
